messages:
carmen_sales: Quick sync — PulseCare is asking for a reserved commit. Need capacity plan + short answers for their security questionnaire.

eli_sre: What numbers did presales use? rps, tokens, model?

carmen_sales: Quote: 38 rps peak, 26 rps steady. Avg tokens ~125. Model: redwood-gpt-3.2-q. Commit in paper: 18M tokens/month.

noah_infra: Peak token rate = 38*125 = 4750 tps -> ~410M/day if sustained. 18M/month is much lower. We should offer: (A) baseline reserve sized for steady; (B) reserve+burst plan for peaks; (C) fallback routing to smaller model.

rita_fin: I can draft two pricing scenarios: baseline reserve for 26 rps, and aggressive reserve for 38 rps with burst credits. Include example monthly bill with token overage math.

maya_prod: Also call out KV-cache warmup for convo context. Recommend default preheat = 5h and note increased tail latency if less.

eli_sre: Autoscale sample to show in appendix:
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas_reserved: 10
  scale_step: 1
  cooldown_s: 45
  burst_pool: hosted-burst
```

noah_infra: Ill run perf sims for quantized 3.2B on H100/A100 and post a small table mapping rps -> GPUs. Will include preheat GPU-hour estimates.

carmen_sales: Customer asked: can we BYOK and restrict region?

noah_infra: BYOK supported for Dedicated/Private, region restriction supported (us-east-1 / eu-west-1). KMS integration needs ~48-72h. Add that to security answers.

eli_sre: Ops blockers to list: KMS, VPC peering or private endpoint, SOC2 report, and an escalation path for AZ-level capacity issues.

ci-bot: scheduled job "pulsecare-preheat-smoke" for 2026-04-08T05:00:00Z. Notified: @noah_infra, @eli_sre.

rita_fin: Legal wants the explicit fallback latency: reserved vs hosted-burst vs smaller-model. Ill include expected p50/p95 bands based on infra sims.

maya_prod: Ill prepare a one-page runbook: sizing matrix, autoscale snippet, routing fallback, KV-warmup guidance, and concise security answers. Draft by EOD tomorrow.

carmen_sales: Timeline: customer confirms monthly semantics today. Noah runs perf sims in 48h. Rita to send pricing scenarios Monday. Maya to draft runbook. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

noah_infra: will post sims and a tiny CSV to this thread when ready.

eli_sre: If we get the anonymized traffic sample under NDA we can finalize reserve recommendation.

carmen_sales: I'll follow up with PulseCare sec for the sample.
